scope: Candidate envelopes only; not proof of presence or a regional allocation database

entries.name: IEEE 802.11 5.8 GHz family
entries.verification: PHY synchronization and integrity-checked packet decoding; only legacy20MHz OFDM receiver installed, other PHYs not covered
entries.notes: Broad envelope, channel availability and occupied bandwidth require regional and observed evidence

entries.name: Proprietary2.4GHz radios including ESB-like links
entries.verification: Generic burst/modulation features first; require protocol-specific sync, packet fields and integrity to confirm ESB or another private protocol
entries.notes: Device purpose such as mouse, remote or sensor cannot be inferred from GFSK alone

entries.name: ANT/ANT+ candidate
entries.verification: Protocol-specific synchronization and integrity checks; periodic short bursts alone do not confirm ANT

entries.name: 2.4GHz LoRa/FLRC family candidate
entries.verification: Test repeated chirp or modulation structure, then require profile-specific synchronization and checked frames
entries.notes: LoRa, FLRC and GFSK are different modes; a linear sweep does not identify any one of them

entries.name: Private digital video/telemetry2.4GHz candidate
entries.verification: Generic waveform characterization, then validated protocol evidence if available; cannot identify drone/vendor by OFDM alone

entries.name: Private digital video/telemetry5.8GHz candidate
entries.verification: Analyze wideband burst and synchronization structure; vendor or device identity needs independent evidence

entries.name: Analog5.8GHz video candidate
entries.verification: FM demodulation plus validated analog-video timing; continuity alone does not confirm video
entries.notes: Candidate RF envelope only; vendor channels and regional availability vary

entries.name: Regional5.8GHz short-range traffic communication candidate
entries.verification: Require region/site context and an applicable protocol profile; not a generic5.8GHz default classification
entries.notes: Historical technical frequency context, NOT a verified current regional authorization

entries.name: Microwave-oven-like leakage/interference candidate
entries.verification: Noise-like spectrum and periodic envelope are only hints; source attribution requires controlled on/off or independent corroboration

entries.name: Other private5.8GHz links or noncommunication activity
entries.verification: Generic structure, temporal activity, signal quality and repeatability; retain unknown protocol and source
entries.notes: Does not claim radar or intentional jamming merely from spectral appearance
